server.schema.2025-12-11.json is an unmodified copy of the official MCP Registry
server.json schema, used by tests/server-json.test.ts to validate server.json offline.

Source: https://static.modelcontextprotocol.io/schemas/2025-12-11/server.schema.json
Fetched: 2026-10-17

To refresh, download the same URL over this file. If server.json moves to a newer
schema, add the new file beside this one and point the test at it.
